title: R16: wire peering auth handshake into session
description: auth.rs has a complete ed25519 challenge-response handshake (run_auth_handshake) but it is never called from run_peering_session. PeeringShared has no trusted_keys field and PeeringConfig has no trusted_peers setting. Wire up: (1) add trusted_peers: Vec<String> to PeeringConfig with #[serde(default)]; (2) parse to Vec<VerifyingKey> at startup; (3) add trusted_keys field to PeeringShared; (4) at start of run_peering_session, if trusted_keys is non-empty, call run_auth_handshake and drop connection on failure; (5) close 5w3.9.
